svg.text: Robot: breadboard wiring (3.3 V logic side)
Full-size breadboard. The ESP32 straddles the middle channel; each of its pins has one free hole: hole a below the bottom row, hole j above the top row.
Bottom rails: + is 3V3, − is GND. Top − rail is GND too. 12 V arrives on two wires only (rows 4); the rest of the 12 V side is robot-power.svg.
SPI mode: switch SEL0 off, SEL1 on
GPIO 17, 18 → rear SDA, SCL, then AHT20
GPIO 10–13 → PN532 SS, MOSI, SCK, MISO
